name: Kevin L.
textEn: Tony is hands down the best stylist for Asian hair in the Research Triangle! I've been getting my two-block haircut here for over 2 years. He pays extreme attention to the shape of your head and texture. Always quick, clean, and consistent.
textZh: Tony绝对是北卡三角区剪亚洲发型最好的发型师！两年来我一直在这里剪两分区发型。他对头型轮廓和打薄层次非常敏锐，剪得又快又精准，每次效果都极度稳定。

name: Michelle Z.
textEn: Expert scissor work over clippers. Tony takes the time to consult and make sure you get the exact proportions you want. Affordable neighborhood prices for master-level cuts.
textZh: 剪刀功夫炉火纯青，绝不敷衍胡乱用电推剪推了事。Tony在剪前会细心沟通发长与比例，以街坊亲民的价格享受到大师级的手艺，十分难得。

name: David R.
textEn: Came in for an Asian two-block cut with a low taper fade on the sides. Tony nailed the silhouette perfectly without thinning out too much. Highly recommended for guys in Cary looking for clean Asian cuts.
textZh: 特地来做韩式两分区剪发加低位渐变推边。Tony对头型轮廓的把控恰到好处，既保留了厚实质感又很利落。凯瑞想剪亚洲风格发型的男生首选！

name: Sarah T.
textEn: Best men's haircut I've had in North Carolina. Tony is super fast yet incredibly meticulous with his scissors. The shampoo and head massage before the cut was super relaxing too.
textZh: 在北卡剪过最满意的一次男士理发。Tony动作利落迅捷，但剪刀细节极其严谨。理发前的洗发和头部舒缓按摩也非常享受放松。

name: Jason W.
textEn: I travel 35 minutes from Durham just to get my haircut by Tony. He understands how coarse straight Asian hair sticks out and blends it seamlessly so it grows out looking natural.
textZh: 我特意从杜伦开车35分钟过来找Tony剪头。他非常懂亚洲人粗硬直发两侧容易炸毛的特点，修剪得非常服帖，长长后依然很自然。

name: Emily C.
textEn: Classic taper fade and clean texture on top. You get a master consultation and precision finish for just $25. Best value in the Triangle without question.
textZh: 经典的渐变推边加上顶部的质感碎发。只要25美元就能享受到首席发型师的定制设计与精细修剪，绝对是整个三角区性价比最高的发廊。

name: Brian P.
textEn: Did the Magic Straightening with Tom and my hair has never been so smooth and silky! It saves me 30 minutes every morning. The pricing is so honest compared to luxury downtown salons. Highly recommend!
textZh: 找Tom做了招牌魔法拉直离子烫，头发前所未有的顺滑光亮！每天早上省下了整整30分钟打理时间。相比市中心那些华而不实的沙龙，这里的收费太良心实在了，强烈推荐！

name: Grace H.
textEn: Tom is a wizard with thermal reconditioning! My coarse, frizzy curls are completely transformed into glossy, pin-straight silk. It's survived North Carolina humidity with zero frizz.
textZh: Tom的热能离子烫技术堪称神奇！原本毛躁凌乱的自然卷被彻底改造成如丝绸般顺滑莹亮的直发，完全经受住了北卡夏天的潮湿天气考验，一点都不炸毛。

name: Alexander K.
textEn: I got Magic Straightening 4 months ago and my hair is still pin-straight, soft, and shiny. Tom was patient through the 3-hour process and made sure my ends weren't damaged at all.
textZh: 四个月前做的魔法拉直，现在头发依然垂顺柔亮。整整三个多小时的过程Tom都极为耐心细致，发尾不仅没有受损反而很有光泽。

name: Wei C.
textEn: My daughter and I both get our Japanese straightening done here every 6 months. Tom takes such good care of the hair integrity. Worth every penny!
textZh: 我和女儿每半年都在这里找Tom做日本离子烫。Tom非常注重保护发质健康，药水温和手法专业，每一分钱都花得超值！

name: Daniel M.
textEn: The digital perm I got here gave my limp hair so much bounce and volume. Best salon experience I've had since moving to North Carolina from California!
textZh: 在这里烫的数码卷发彻底拯救了我细软扁塌的发质，蓬松富有弹性。这是我从加州搬到北卡后遇到的最满意的美发沙龙！

name: Jessica H.
textEn: Got a Korean-style textured wave perm from Tom. It gives me effortless wavy texture every morning with just a little sea salt spray. Exactly what I wanted.
textZh: 找Tom烫了韩式微潮纹理烫，每天早上稍微喷一点造型喷雾就能抓出好看的蓬松层次，正是我想要的效果。

name: Ryan O.
textEn: Traditional perm with bouncy, durable body. The curls are soft and natural instead of frizzy or dry. Tom explained the post-perm washing care thoroughly.
textZh: 烫的传统弹润卷发很有弹性，卷度柔和自然，一点都不毛燥干枯。Tom还特别详尽地讲解了烫发后的清洗和日常护理注意事项。

name: Linda W.
textEn: Did a men's down perm for the sides and a loose wave on top. Solved my bushy sideburn problem instantly. Tony and Tom really understand Asian hair trends.
textZh: 做了男士侧边服帖烫（Down Perm）加顶部自然微卷。彻底解决了两侧头发炸毛蓬乱的问题，Tony和Tom对亚洲当季潮流发型太精通了。

name: Steven Y.
textEn: Tom did my balayage and highlights. The blend is so seamless and doesn't get brassy at all. Their products smell amazing and leave your hair feeling soft instead of damaged. 10/10!
textZh: Tom帮我做的巴黎画染和挑染，色彩过渡毫无断层，完全没有发黄毛糙的问题！沙龙用的产品香味高级，染后头发不仅没受损反而格外丝滑。满分体验！

name: Marcus B.
textEn: Single process rich chocolate brown color with root touch up. The shade came out rich, uniform, and glossy. Very reasonably priced for such high quality formulas.
textZh: 做的浓郁巧克力冷棕全染加补发根。色泽饱满均匀、光泽感十足。使用高档沙龙染膏但收费亲民合理，性价比极高。

name: Chloe L.
textEn: Gorgeous sun-kissed partial highlights! Tom placed the foils strategically around my face to brighten my complexion. Loved the blowout finish at the end.
textZh: 超美的阳光感局部挑染！Tom在脸庞周围的挑染位置设计得非常巧妙，整个人气色瞬间提亮。最后的蓬松吹风造型也很赞。

name: Eric F.
textEn: I was nervous about bleaching my dark hair for ash blonde highlights, but Tom took great precautions with deep conditioning treatments. No breakage and the tone is stunning.
textZh: 深色头发做亚麻灰金挑染本来很担心漂发受损，但Tom加了深层结构护理，发丝完全没有断裂，冷调色彩高级惊艳。

name: Samantha G.
textEn: Finally found a salon in the Cary area that understands thick, straight hair! Got beautiful long layers and face-framing curtain bangs. You can tell they have decades of international training.
textZh: 终于在凯瑞找到一家真正懂得修剪粗硬厚重直发的沙龙！修出的长层次和法式修颜八字刘海太美了，明显能感受到发型师深厚的国际化从业功底。

name: Michael T.
textEn: Designer haircut and blowout for $35 is an unbelievable deal for this caliber of craftsmanship. My hair feels so lightweight and airy without losing its natural volume.
textZh: 35美元的设计师剪发加吹风造型，手艺好到难以置信。修剪后的头发轻盈灵动，层次丰富又完全不失原本的丰盈感。

name: Hannah J.
textEn: I got a blunt chin-length bob cut here and the precision is remarkable. Perfectly even from all angles. Tony takes pride in his scissor geometry.
textZh: 在这里剪了齐下巴的干练鲍伯头，几何线条精准得令人惊叹，各个角度看都毫无瑕疵。Tony对剪刀线条的把握堪称大师级。

name: Christopher D.
textEn: Great family atmosphere! I bring my two young boys here for their cuts and they love how gentle and fast Tony is. Plus, they gladly honor the military discount for veterans. A true neighborhood staple.
textZh: 非常温馨亲切的家庭式发廊！我经常带两个小儿子来剪头发，Tony既温柔又有耐心，动作特别利索。最感动的是他们非常尊重退伍老兵并提供军人优惠，真正值得信赖的好店！

name: Sophia Z.
textEn: Brought my 4-year-old son who usually cries during haircuts. Tony was so patient and quick that my son didn't shed a single tear! Cute, handsome cut too.
textZh: 带我平时一理发就哭闹的4岁儿子来，Tony非常耐心温柔，手法麻利，孩子全程一声都没哭，剪出来的清爽小正太头特别帅气。

name: Derek V.
textEn: The whole family gets cut here—my husband, myself, and our 8-year-old daughter. Consistent quality every single visit. We wouldn't go anywhere else in Cary.
textZh: 我们全家都在这里理发——我先生、我和8岁的女儿。每次来水准都始终如一的稳定，在凯瑞绝对找不到第二家这么贴心的发廊。

name: Rachel N.
textEn: As an active service member stationed nearby, I truly appreciate their military community discount. Great haircut, welcoming stylists, and honorable service.
textZh: 作为常驻附近的现役军人，非常感谢他们提供的军人专属感恩折扣。发型利落清爽，待人真诚热情，令人肃然起敬的好店。

name: Andrew S.
textEn: Retired veteran here. They gladly honored my military ID at checkout with a warm thank you. The haircut was sharp, clean, and professional. 5 stars all the way.
textZh: 退役老兵路过。结账时店员热情致谢并提供了军人优惠。剪发干净利落、精神板正，五星好评当之无愧！

name: Jennifer K.
textEn: Super convenient location right on NW Maynard Rd with lots of free parking. Walked in on a Tuesday, was greeted warmly in both Chinese and English, and got an incredible fade. Will definitely be a regular.
textZh: 就在NW Maynard路旁，位置极其方便，门前大片免费停车位。周二下午直接到店，中英文双语问候非常贴心，渐变推边做得无懈可击，以后锁定这家了！

name: Brandon L.
textEn: Being able to communicate fluently in Mandarin Chinese made it so easy to explain exactly the style I wanted from my favorite Asian drama. Tony got it immediately!
textZh: 能用中文无障碍交流实在太方便了，向Tony解释我想要某部热播亚剧里的发型，他立刻心领神会，剪出来的效果一模一样！

name: Megan B.
textEn: Clean salon, professional tools, warm wash basins, and friendly veteran stylists. Walk-ins are accommodated smoothly. Cary is lucky to have Tony Hair Salon.
textZh: 沙龙干净整洁，器具消毒彻底，洗发水温适宜，发型师资深热情。散客也能妥善安排，凯瑞有这样一家口碑沙龙非常幸运。

textZh: 沙龙干净整洁，器具消毒彻底，洗发水温适宜，发型师资深热情。散客也能妥善安排，凯瑞有这样一家口碑沙龙非常幸运。

name: Rebecca S.
textEn: Tony is hands down the best stylist for Asian hair in the Research Triangle! I've been getting my two-block haircut here for over 2 years. He pays extreme attention to the shape of your head and texture. Always quick, clean, and consistent.
textZh: Tony绝对是北卡三角区剪亚洲发型最好的发型师！两年来我一直在这里剪两分区发型。他对头型轮廓和打薄层次非常敏锐，剪得又快又精准，每次效果都极度稳定。

name: Sean D.
textEn: Expert scissor work over clippers. Tony takes the time to consult and make sure you get the exact proportions you want. Affordable neighborhood prices for master-level cuts.
textZh: 剪刀功夫炉火纯青，绝不敷衍胡乱用电推剪推了事。Tony在剪前会细心沟通发长与比例，以街坊亲民的价格享受到大师级的手艺，十分难得。

name: Katherine F.
textEn: Came in for an Asian two-block cut with a low taper fade on the sides. Tony nailed the silhouette perfectly without thinning out too much. Highly recommended for guys in Cary looking for clean Asian cuts.
textZh: 特地来做韩式两分区剪发加低位渐变推边。Tony对头型轮廓的把控恰到好处，既保留了厚实质感又很利落。凯瑞想剪亚洲风格发型的男生首选！

name: Jeremy W.
textEn: Best men's haircut I've had in North Carolina. Tony is super fast yet incredibly meticulous with his scissors. The shampoo and head massage before the cut was super relaxing too.
textZh: 在北卡剪过最满意的一次男士理发。Tony动作利落迅捷，但剪刀细节极其严谨。理发前的洗发和头部舒缓按摩也非常享受放松。

name: Vanessa L.
textEn: I travel 35 minutes from Durham just to get my haircut by Tony. He understands how coarse straight Asian hair sticks out and blends it seamlessly so it grows out looking natural.
textZh: 我特意从杜伦开车35分钟过来找Tony剪头。他非常懂亚洲人粗硬直发两侧容易炸毛的特点，修剪得非常服帖，长长后依然很自然。

name: Travis C.
textEn: Classic taper fade and clean texture on top. You get a master consultation and precision finish for just $25. Best value in the Triangle without question.
textZh: 经典的渐变推边加上顶部的质感碎发。只要25美元就能享受到首席发型师的定制设计与精细修剪，绝对是整个三角区性价比最高的发廊。

name: Kelsey M.
textEn: Did the Magic Straightening with Tom and my hair has never been so smooth and silky! It saves me 30 minutes every morning. The pricing is so honest compared to luxury downtown salons. Highly recommend!
textZh: 找Tom做了招牌魔法拉直离子烫，头发前所未有的顺滑光亮！每天早上省下了整整30分钟打理时间。相比市中心那些华而不实的沙龙，这里的收费太良心实在了，强烈推荐！

name: Adam R.
textEn: Tom is a wizard with thermal reconditioning! My coarse, frizzy curls are completely transformed into glossy, pin-straight silk. It's survived North Carolina humidity with zero frizz.
textZh: Tom的热能离子烫技术堪称神奇！原本毛躁凌乱的自然卷被彻底改造成如丝绸般顺滑莹亮的直发，完全经受住了北卡夏天的潮湿天气考验，一点都不炸毛。

name: Courtney T.
textEn: I got Magic Straightening 4 months ago and my hair is still pin-straight, soft, and shiny. Tom was patient through the 3-hour process and made sure my ends weren't damaged at all.
textZh: 四个月前做的魔法拉直，现在头发依然垂顺柔亮。整整三个多小时的过程Tom都极为耐心细致，发尾不仅没有受损反而很有光泽。

name: Gregory P.
textEn: My daughter and I both get our Japanese straightening done here every 6 months. Tom takes such good care of the hair integrity. Worth every penny!
textZh: 我和女儿每半年都在这里找Tom做日本离子烫。Tom非常注重保护发质健康，药水温和手法专业，每一分钱都花得超值！

name: Brooke S.
textEn: The digital perm I got here gave my limp hair so much bounce and volume. Best salon experience I've had since moving to North Carolina from California!
textZh: 在这里烫的数码卷发彻底拯救了我细软扁塌的发质，蓬松富有弹性。这是我从加州搬到北卡后遇到的最满意的美发沙龙！

name: Bradley H.
textEn: Got a Korean-style textured wave perm from Tom. It gives me effortless wavy texture every morning with just a little sea salt spray. Exactly what I wanted.
textZh: 找Tom烫了韩式微潮纹理烫，每天早上稍微喷一点造型喷雾就能抓出好看的蓬松层次，正是我想要的效果。

name: Allison K.
textEn: Traditional perm with bouncy, durable body. The curls are soft and natural instead of frizzy or dry. Tom explained the post-perm washing care thoroughly.
textZh: 烫的传统弹润卷发很有弹性，卷度柔和自然，一点都不毛燥干枯。Tom还特别详尽地讲解了烫发后的清洗和日常护理注意事项。

name: Cody M.
textEn: Did a men's down perm for the sides and a loose wave on top. Solved my bushy sideburn problem instantly. Tony and Tom really understand Asian hair trends.
textZh: 做了男士侧边服帖烫（Down Perm）加顶部自然微卷。彻底解决了两侧头发炸毛蓬乱的问题，Tony和Tom对亚洲当季潮流发型太精通了。

name: Haley W.
textEn: Tom did my balayage and highlights. The blend is so seamless and doesn't get brassy at all. Their products smell amazing and leave your hair feeling soft instead of damaged. 10/10!
textZh: Tom帮我做的巴黎画染和挑染，色彩过渡毫无断层，完全没有发黄毛糙的问题！沙龙用的产品香味高级，染后头发不仅没受损反而格外丝滑。满分体验！

name: Jesse B.
textEn: Single process rich chocolate brown color with root touch up. The shade came out rich, uniform, and glossy. Very reasonably priced for such high quality formulas.
textZh: 做的浓郁巧克力冷棕全染加补发根。色泽饱满均匀、光泽感十足。使用高档沙龙染膏但收费亲民合理，性价比极高。

name: Paige L.
textEn: Gorgeous sun-kissed partial highlights! Tom placed the foils strategically around my face to brighten my complexion. Loved the blowout finish at the end.
textZh: 超美的阳光感局部挑染！Tom在脸庞周围的挑染位置设计得非常巧妙，整个人气色瞬间提亮。最后的蓬松吹风造型也很赞。

name: Trevor D.
textEn: I was nervous about bleaching my dark hair for ash blonde highlights, but Tom took great precautions with deep conditioning treatments. No breakage and the tone is stunning.
textZh: 深色头发做亚麻灰金挑染本来很担心漂发受损，但Tom加了深层结构护理，发丝完全没有断裂，冷调色彩高级惊艳。

name: Morgan S.
textEn: Finally found a salon in the Cary area that understands thick, straight hair! Got beautiful long layers and face-framing curtain bangs. You can tell they have decades of international training.
textZh: 终于在凯瑞找到一家真正懂得修剪粗硬厚重直发的沙龙！修出的长层次和法式修颜八字刘海太美了，明显能感受到发型师深厚的国际化从业功底。

name: Lucas T.
textEn: Designer haircut and blowout for $35 is an unbelievable deal for this caliber of craftsmanship. My hair feels so lightweight and airy without losing its natural volume.
textZh: 35美元的设计师剪发加吹风造型，手艺好到难以置信。修剪后的头发轻盈灵动，层次丰富又完全不失原本的丰盈感。

name: Sydney C.
textEn: I got a blunt chin-length bob cut here and the precision is remarkable. Perfectly even from all angles. Tony takes pride in his scissor geometry.
textZh: 在这里剪了齐下巴的干练鲍伯头，几何线条精准得令人惊叹，各个角度看都毫无瑕疵。Tony对剪刀线条的把握堪称大师级。

name: Aaron M.
textEn: Great family atmosphere! I bring my two young boys here for their cuts and they love how gentle and fast Tony is. Plus, they gladly honor the military discount for veterans. A true neighborhood staple.
textZh: 非常温馨亲切的家庭式发廊！我经常带两个小儿子来剪头发，Tony既温柔又有耐心，动作特别利索。最感动的是他们非常尊重退伍老兵并提供军人优惠，真正值得信赖的好店！

name: Erica H.
textEn: Brought my 4-year-old son who usually cries during haircuts. Tony was so patient and quick that my son didn't shed a single tear! Cute, handsome cut too.
textZh: 带我平时一理发就哭闹的4岁儿子来，Tony非常耐心温柔，手法麻利，孩子全程一声都没哭，剪出来的清爽小正太头特别帅气。

name: Dylan P.
textEn: The whole family gets cut here—my husband, myself, and our 8-year-old daughter. Consistent quality every single visit. We wouldn't go anywhere else in Cary.
textZh: 我们全家都在这里理发——我先生、我和8岁的女儿。每次来水准都始终如一的稳定，在凯瑞绝对找不到第二家这么贴心的发廊。

name: Lindsey F.
textEn: As an active service member stationed nearby, I truly appreciate their military community discount. Great haircut, welcoming stylists, and honorable service.
textZh: 作为常驻附近的现役军人，非常感谢他们提供的军人专属感恩折扣。发型利落清爽，待人真诚热情，令人肃然起敬的好店。

name: Colin B.
textEn: Retired veteran here. They gladly honored my military ID at checkout with a warm thank you. The haircut was sharp, clean, and professional. 5 stars all the way.
textZh: 退役老兵路过。结账时店员热情致谢并提供了军人优惠。剪发干净利落、精神板正，五星好评当之无愧！

name: Taylor W.
textEn: Super convenient location right on NW Maynard Rd with lots of free parking. Walked in on a Tuesday, was greeted warmly in both Chinese and English, and got an incredible fade. Will definitely be a regular.
textZh: 就在NW Maynard路旁，位置极其方便，门前大片免费停车位。周二下午直接到店，中英文双语问候非常贴心，渐变推边做得无懈可击，以后锁定这家了！

name: Ian S.
textEn: Being able to communicate fluently in Mandarin Chinese made it so easy to explain exactly the style I wanted from my favorite Asian drama. Tony got it immediately!
textZh: 能用中文无障碍交流实在太方便了，向Tony解释我想要某部热播亚剧里的发型，他立刻心领神会，剪出来的效果一模一样！

textZh: 能用中文无障碍交流实在太方便了，向Tony解释我想要某部热播亚剧里的发型，他立刻心领神会，剪出来的效果一模一样！

name: Luke B.
textEn: Clean salon, professional tools, warm wash basins, and friendly veteran stylists. Walk-ins are accommodated smoothly. Cary is lucky to have Tony Hair Salon.
textZh: 沙龙干净整洁，器具消毒彻底，洗发水温适宜，发型师资深热情。散客也能妥善安排，凯瑞有这样一家口碑沙龙非常幸运。

name: Kendall M.
textEn: Tony is hands down the best stylist for Asian hair in the Research Triangle! I've been getting my two-block haircut here for over 2 years. He pays extreme attention to the shape of your head and texture. Always quick, clean, and consistent.
textZh: Tony绝对是北卡三角区剪亚洲发型最好的发型师！两年来我一直在这里剪两分区发型。他对头型轮廓和打薄层次非常敏锐，剪得又快又精准，每次效果都极度稳定。

name: Gavin P.
textEn: Expert scissor work over clippers. Tony takes the time to consult and make sure you get the exact proportions you want. Affordable neighborhood prices for master-level cuts.
textZh: 剪刀功夫炉火纯青，绝不敷衍胡乱用电推剪推了事。Tony在剪前会细心沟通发长与比例，以街坊亲民的价格享受到大师级的手艺，十分难得。

name: Cassidy T.
textEn: Came in for an Asian two-block cut with a low taper fade on the sides. Tony nailed the silhouette perfectly without thinning out too much. Highly recommended for guys in Cary looking for clean Asian cuts.
textZh: 特地来做韩式两分区剪发加低位渐变推边。Tony对头型轮廓的把控恰到好处，既保留了厚实质感又很利落。凯瑞想剪亚洲风格发型的男生首选！

name: Hayden S.
textEn: Best men's haircut I've had in North Carolina. Tony is super fast yet incredibly meticulous with his scissors. The shampoo and head massage before the cut was super relaxing too.
textZh: 在北卡剪过最满意的一次男士理发。Tony动作利落迅捷，但剪刀细节极其严谨。理发前的洗发和头部舒缓按摩也非常享受放松。

name: Peyton L.
textEn: I travel 35 minutes from Durham just to get my haircut by Tony. He understands how coarse straight Asian hair sticks out and blends it seamlessly so it grows out looking natural.
textZh: 我特意从杜伦开车35分钟过来找Tony剪头。他非常懂亚洲人粗硬直发两侧容易炸毛的特点，修剪得非常服帖，长长后依然很自然。

name: Oliver W.
textEn: Classic taper fade and clean texture on top. You get a master consultation and precision finish for just $25. Best value in the Triangle without question.
textZh: 经典的渐变推边加上顶部的质感碎发。只要25美元就能享受到首席发型师的定制设计与精细修剪，绝对是整个三角区性价比最高的发廊。

name: Brooke R.
textEn: Did the Magic Straightening with Tom and my hair has never been so smooth and silky! It saves me 30 minutes every morning. The pricing is so honest compared to luxury downtown salons. Highly recommend!
textZh: 找Tom做了招牌魔法拉直离子烫，头发前所未有的顺滑光亮！每天早上省下了整整30分钟打理时间。相比市中心那些华而不实的沙龙，这里的收费太良心实在了，强烈推荐！

name: Ethan C.
textEn: Tom is a wizard with thermal reconditioning! My coarse, frizzy curls are completely transformed into glossy, pin-straight silk. It's survived North Carolina humidity with zero frizz.
textZh: Tom的热能离子烫技术堪称神奇！原本毛躁凌乱的自然卷被彻底改造成如丝绸般顺滑莹亮的直发，完全经受住了北卡夏天的潮湿天气考验，一点都不炸毛。

name: Mariah M.
textEn: I got Magic Straightening 4 months ago and my hair is still pin-straight, soft, and shiny. Tom was patient through the 3-hour process and made sure my ends weren't damaged at all.
textZh: 四个月前做的魔法拉直，现在头发依然垂顺柔亮。整整三个多小时的过程Tom都极为耐心细致，发尾不仅没有受损反而很有光泽。

name: Isaac H.
textEn: My daughter and I both get our Japanese straightening done here every 6 months. Tom takes such good care of the hair integrity. Worth every penny!
textZh: 我和女儿每半年都在这里找Tom做日本离子烫。Tom非常注重保护发质健康，药水温和手法专业，每一分钱都花得超值！

name: Alana T.
textEn: The digital perm I got here gave my limp hair so much bounce and volume. Best salon experience I've had since moving to North Carolina from California!
textZh: 在这里烫的数码卷发彻底拯救了我细软扁塌的发质，蓬松富有弹性。这是我从加州搬到北卡后遇到的最满意的美发沙龙！

name: Gabriel S.
textEn: Got a Korean-style textured wave perm from Tom. It gives me effortless wavy texture every morning with just a little sea salt spray. Exactly what I wanted.
textZh: 找Tom烫了韩式微潮纹理烫，每天早上稍微喷一点造型喷雾就能抓出好看的蓬松层次，正是我想要的效果。

name: Katelyn K.
textEn: Traditional perm with bouncy, durable body. The curls are soft and natural instead of frizzy or dry. Tom explained the post-perm washing care thoroughly.
textZh: 烫的传统弹润卷发很有弹性，卷度柔和自然，一点都不毛燥干枯。Tom还特别详尽地讲解了烫发后的清洗和日常护理注意事项。

name: Wyatt B.
textEn: Did a men's down perm for the sides and a loose wave on top. Solved my bushy sideburn problem instantly. Tony and Tom really understand Asian hair trends.
textZh: 做了男士侧边服帖烫（Down Perm）加顶部自然微卷。彻底解决了两侧头发炸毛蓬乱的问题，Tony和Tom对亚洲当季潮流发型太精通了。

name: Jordan F.
textEn: Tom did my balayage and highlights. The blend is so seamless and doesn't get brassy at all. Their products smell amazing and leave your hair feeling soft instead of damaged. 10/10!
textZh: Tom帮我做的巴黎画染和挑染，色彩过渡毫无断层，完全没有发黄毛糙的问题！沙龙用的产品香味高级，染后头发不仅没受损反而格外丝滑。满分体验！

name: Christian M.
textEn: Single process rich chocolate brown color with root touch up. The shade came out rich, uniform, and glossy. Very reasonably priced for such high quality formulas.
textZh: 做的浓郁巧克力冷棕全染加补发根。色泽饱满均匀、光泽感十足。使用高档沙龙染膏但收费亲民合理，性价比极高。

name: Leslie W.
textEn: Gorgeous sun-kissed partial highlights! Tom placed the foils strategically around my face to brighten my complexion. Loved the blowout finish at the end.
textZh: 超美的阳光感局部挑染！Tom在脸庞周围的挑染位置设计得非常巧妙，整个人气色瞬间提亮。最后的蓬松吹风造型也很赞。

name: Hunter P.
textEn: I was nervous about bleaching my dark hair for ash blonde highlights, but Tom took great precautions with deep conditioning treatments. No breakage and the tone is stunning.
textZh: 深色头发做亚麻灰金挑染本来很担心漂发受损，但Tom加了深层结构护理，发丝完全没有断裂，冷调色彩高级惊艳。

name: Carly S.
textEn: Finally found a salon in the Cary area that understands thick, straight hair! Got beautiful long layers and face-framing curtain bangs. You can tell they have decades of international training.
textZh: 终于在凯瑞找到一家真正懂得修剪粗硬厚重直发的沙龙！修出的长层次和法式修颜八字刘海太美了，明显能感受到发型师深厚的国际化从业功底。

name: Landon T.
textEn: Designer haircut and blowout for $35 is an unbelievable deal for this caliber of craftsmanship. My hair feels so lightweight and airy without losing its natural volume.
textZh: 35美元的设计师剪发加吹风造型，手艺好到难以置信。修剪后的头发轻盈灵动，层次丰富又完全不失原本的丰盈感。

name: Miranda H.
textEn: I got a blunt chin-length bob cut here and the precision is remarkable. Perfectly even from all angles. Tony takes pride in his scissor geometry.
textZh: 在这里剪了齐下巴的干练鲍伯头，几何线条精准得令人惊叹，各个角度看都毫无瑕疵。Tony对剪刀线条的把握堪称大师级。

name: Carter B.
textEn: Great family atmosphere! I bring my two young boys here for their cuts and they love how gentle and fast Tony is. Plus, they gladly honor the military discount for veterans. A true neighborhood staple.
textZh: 非常温馨亲切的家庭式发廊！我经常带两个小儿子来剪头发，Tony既温柔又有耐心，动作特别利索。最感动的是他们非常尊重退伍老兵并提供军人优惠，真正值得信赖的好店！

name: Melanie K.
textEn: Brought my 4-year-old son who usually cries during haircuts. Tony was so patient and quick that my son didn't shed a single tear! Cute, handsome cut too.
textZh: 带我平时一理发就哭闹的4岁儿子来，Tony非常耐心温柔，手法麻利，孩子全程一声都没哭，剪出来的清爽小正太头特别帅气。

name: Levi S.
textEn: The whole family gets cut here—my husband, myself, and our 8-year-old daughter. Consistent quality every single visit. We wouldn't go anywhere else in Cary.
textZh: 我们全家都在这里理发——我先生、我和8岁的女儿。每次来水准都始终如一的稳定，在凯瑞绝对找不到第二家这么贴心的发廊。

name: Valerie M.
textEn: As an active service member stationed nearby, I truly appreciate their military community discount. Great haircut, welcoming stylists, and honorable service.
textZh: 作为常驻附近的现役军人，非常感谢他们提供的军人专属感恩折扣。发型利落清爽，待人真诚热情，令人肃然起敬的好店。

name: Brayden W.
textEn: Retired veteran here. They gladly honored my military ID at checkout with a warm thank you. The haircut was sharp, clean, and professional. 5 stars all the way.
textZh: 退役老兵路过。结账时店员热情致谢并提供了军人优惠。剪发干净利落、精神板正，五星好评当之无愧！

name: Jenna F.
textEn: Super convenient location right on NW Maynard Rd with lots of free parking. Walked in on a Tuesday, was greeted warmly in both Chinese and English, and got an incredible fade. Will definitely be a regular.
textZh: 就在NW Maynard路旁，位置极其方便，门前大片免费停车位。周二下午直接到店，中英文双语问候非常贴心，渐变推边做得无懈可击，以后锁定这家了！

textEn: Being able to communicate fluently in Mandarin Chinese made it so easy to explain exactly the style I wanted from my favorite Asian drama. Tony got it immediately!
